body:
It started as just another project idea at NIAT Jaipur—something my team and I were already working on with curiosity and ambition. Little did we know that this idea would soon take us all the way to the Buildathon Finals in Delhi.


I, along with my two teammates, got the opportunity to represent NIAT Jaipur at the NIAT x OpenAI Buildathon Finals under the AI Impact Summit 2025. The journey began when we came across the announcement of the Buildathon being hosted at NIAT Jaipur. What made it even more exciting was that it wasn’t limited to NIAT students—participants from outside could join as well. The energy around the event was unmatched, and we knew we had to be a part of it.


The Buildathon Experience

Day 1 kicked off with enthusiasm and excitement. From collecting goodies to meeting mentors and other participants, everything felt new and inspiring. The hackathon ran for 9 intense hours, pushing us to think, adapt, and improve continuously. Our mentors played a crucial role—they were approachable, insightful, and always ready to guide us. By the end of the first day, we had significantly refined our project, making key improvements that boosted both our confidence and clarity.


Day 2 brought a different kind of pressure. The submission deadline was 12 PM, and we had to prepare everything—our project explanation, GitHub repository, and presentation. Like many hackathon teams, we found ourselves racing against time and ended up submitting everything at the very last minute. It was stressful, but also thrilling.


The Moment That Changed Everything

As the results announcement approached, the atmosphere was filled with nervous anticipation. Hundreds of teams had participated, and only 9 were going to be selected for the finals. When our team name—Fox Tech—was announced, it felt surreal. All the hard work, sleepless hours, and teamwork had paid off.


Being selected for the finals wasn’t just an achievement; it was a moment of pride for all of us. Representing our institution at such a prestigious platform is both an honor and a responsibility we carry with excitement.


Looking Ahead

This journey has been more than just a competition—it has been a learning experience filled with growth, collaboration, and resilience. From brainstorming ideas to standing among the top teams, every moment has shaped us.

This is just the beginning. 🚀
title: From Idea to Impact: Our Journey to the Buildathon Finals
meta_title: NIAT Jaipur Student Reaches Buildathon Finals in Delhi
meta_description: A real NIAT student shares how their team made it to the top 9 out of hundreds in the NIAT x OpenAI Buildathon. Find out what it takes to win.
